resources.purpose: The two Excel workbooks that army-generation-rules.json was normalized from, kept for maintainers who change the rules data. The generator never reads them.
resources.whenMissing: Nothing changes for generation. tests/Test-ProtectedSources.ps1 skips the workbook hash checks.
resources.howToObtain: Maintainers only. Keep your own copies of 'Fire and Fury Army Creation Tables.xlsx' and 'Fire and Fury Label Generator.xlsx' in this folder.

resources.purpose: A CSV of real unit and commander names that the PDF test suite uses to build two extra fixtures with historical names.
resources.whenMissing: The generator works as usual. tests/Test-PdfFixtures.ps1 skips the two real-name fixtures and runs the golden and synthetic ones.
resources.howToObtain: Maintainers only. Build a CSV with the columns Label_ID, Faction, Label_Type, Unit_Type, Commander and Unit_Name from your own order-of-battle research.
